# Tool inventory

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/tool_inventory.py` from the live tools/list catalog. Do not edit by hand. -->

Catalog the server announces through `tools/list`, read over stdio with a real handshake (it is not derived from the source code). `tests/test_tool_inventory.py` fails if this file and the catalog diverge; it is regenerated with `uv run python scripts/tool_inventory.py`.

## Contract version

**2.0.0.** The server announces it on the first line of the `initialize` `instructions` (`knowledge-contract: 2.0.0`); its history lives in `docs/contract/CHANGELOG.md`. `serverInfo` says `name: Knowledge`, `version: 1.27.0`, but that version is the `mcp` SDK's (FastMCP fills it in with the package version when the server does not declare one), not the contract's. Negotiated protocol: `2025-11-25`.

Text output (`KNOWLEDGE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT=0`, the default): the text blocks are each tool's canonical response. With `1` every tool also declares `outputSchema` and every response carries `structuredContent`, the same JSON; the catalog order does not change.

## Profiles

`all` (the default) registers the core tools and, after them, those of each extension that some served vault declares: it is the catalog above. `legacy` registers the 1.4.0 catalog, name by name and in its order, with the responses of this contract: the `flows`, `governance` and `confluence` tools without looking at `features`, and the retired tools. It is chosen with `serve --profile` or `KNOWLEDGE_PROFILE` (the flag wins).

## Retired

| Tool | Retired in | Under `all` |
|---|---|---|
| `search_code` | 2.0.0 | `E_TOOL_RETIRED`; only the `legacy` profile lists it |

## `get_document`

Read a vault doc: chunk_id (from a search row) reads one heading's block, file_path optional; section= a heading, start_line/end_line a range. max_chars=3000 caps text; truncated=True: narrow. full_metadata=True: all frontmatter. fields= trims keys.

Since contract 1.0.0.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_path` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `section` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `start_line` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `end_line` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `max_chars` | integer | no | `3000` |
| `include_metadata` | boolean \| null | no | `null` |
| `chunk_id` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `fields` | array \| null | no | `null` |
| `full_metadata` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `vault` | string \| null | no | `null` |

Response: declares no `outputSchema`.

## `search`

Hybrid search (mode hybrid|semantic|keyword, limit 1-50); rows: file_path, score (ordinal, not a probability), chunk_id, section to read. fields= adds excerpt; snippet=True; include_memories=True. rerank='on': vault judge, rerank_score a probability.

Since contract 1.0.0.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |

| `query` | string | yes | — |
| `limit` | integer | no | `5` |
| `mode` | string | no | `"hybrid"` |
| `excerpt_chars` | integer | no | `120` |

| `fields` | array \| null | no | `null` |
| `snippet` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `vault` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `rerank` | string \| null | no | `null` |

Response: declares no `outputSchema`.

## `search_by_metadata`

Filter docs by frontmatter type, service, tag (e.g. service/middleware) and status, AND-ed. Answers {total, offset, items}, items by path: limit (20, max 200) and offset page them; facets=True counts values instead. fields= trims items.

Since contract 1.0.0.

## `reindex`

Re-index the vault by file hash; only target='vault'. force=True re-embeds every file (a paid full embedding run; needed to backfill new metadata). pull=True runs git pull first (the push webhook already pulls); vault_sync says how it went.

Since contract 1.0.0.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | no | `"vault"` |
| `force` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `pull` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `vault` | string \| null | no | `null` |

Response: declares no `outputSchema`.

## `get_stale_docs`

Docs due for revalidation and the owning team (owner, owner_source). reason: overdue (age_days past type threshold), last_updated_invalid (include_unreadable=False drops it) or, with missing_last_updated=True, last_updated_missing. owner= filters.

Since contract 1.0.0.

It only appears when some served vault declares the `governance` extension in `features` (transport http and stdio); without it the catalog does not list it and calling it answers `E_FEATURE_DISABLED`. The `legacy` profile registers it without looking at `features`.

| `limit` | integer | no | `30` |
| `include_unreadable` | boolean | no | `true` |
| `missing_last_updated` | boolean | no | `false` |

## `sync_confluence`

Report vault files under scope_prefix (default Conventions/) whose Confluence page is newer; files outside it are listed. Read-only: dry_run=False is E_WRITE_FENCED; use `cloudfrog-knowledge confluence export`. Without credentials: E_SECRET_MISSING.

Since contract 1.0.0.

It only appears when some served vault declares the `confluence` extension in `features` (transport http and stdio); without it the catalog does not list it and calling it answers `E_FEATURE_DISABLED`. The `legacy` profile registers it without looking at `features`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `true` |
| `scope_prefix` | string | no | `"Conventions/"` |
| `vault` | string \| null | no | `null` |

Response: declares no `outputSchema`.

## `sync_jira`

Admin. Mirror the issues of the vault's integrations.jira projects into memory tasks (upsert by jira_key). dry_run=True (default) only reads Jira; since= ISO date or -7d.

Since contract 1.3.0.

It only appears when some served vault declares the `jira` extension in `features` (transport stdio); without it the catalog does not list it and calling it answers `E_FEATURE_DISABLED`.

| `dry_run` | boolean | no | `true` |
